monomial_encoding: Each hexadecimal string is an exact nonnegative bitmask. Bit j selects factor_alphabet[j]. Multiply selected physical face values; sum all listed products modulo2. There are no unlisted coefficients or implicit index expansions.
domain: Closed binary s1 and omega2; sign-twisted closed integer n2. Every factor is a literal value on the listed physical root face (0ij) or edge (0i) of simplex0123456.
integer_scope: All integers, including negatives with mathematical floor. Dependence on each independent integer root face has period8, proved from the fixed source formula.
